result:
If I could change just one thing, it would be to make empathy automatic and contagious.

Not just the feeling of sympathy for people far away, but the practiced ability to instantly imagine the world as it feels from the other person's side — to hear what they mean, not just what they say, and to feel a real cost when you cause harm, even unintentionally.

Everything else — less violence, less waste, better decisions, more cooperation — tends to follow from that one shift.
